coach.text: One minute to go. Breathe — you are more prepared than most people booking right now.
Keep your backup — Split via Kota — open in a second tab, just in case.
Open your UPI app now so payment is a single tap when it matters.
Set your boarding station to Borivali (BVI) — not Mumbai Central. This is your edge.
When it opens, do not refresh repeatedly. It slows you down and can log you out.
Your passengers auto-fill from the Vault — that alone saves you about 90 seconds.
Almost there. Fill fast, pay immediately, don't second-guess the plan.
